text_phone_number='5708520672'

# Fetch all text messages from the given phone number (paginated)
all_text_ids=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=text_phone_number, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('text_page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    # collect ids
    all_text_ids.extend([m['text_message_id'] for m in page])
    page_index += 1

print('total_text_messages_found', len(all_text_ids))
print('text_ids_sample', all_text_ids[:20])

# Delete text messages
results_text=[]
for tid in text_ids:
    out = apis.phone.delete_text_message(access_token=phone_token, text_message_id=tid)
    results_text.append((tid, out))
    print('deleted_text', tid, out)
print('text_deleted_count', len(results_text))

voice_ids=[17022, 17032, 17026, 17034, 17042, 17024, 17046, 17040, 17044, 17028, 17038, 17036, 17030]
